title: Stolen Luggage, A Visit To The Sub-basements.
content: My first trip to the sub-basements. I was at a seminar, we were told to leave our luggage on benches. After the seminar we came back to see people taking off with our bags. When questioned, the person took off running, he went through a door down several flights of stairs to a vast series of connected rooms and hall ways. The luggage theft seems to be big business. There were thousands of suit cases, trunks and bags, stacked neatly and in random piles. Few of the people spoke English, I had the sensation that I did not belong there. I found a person I could talk to and he let me look around for my bag, no luck. The lecture was boring, I had awful seating, bad audio. I did get a good cup of coffee. The Barista looked stressed, I kidded with her, but she was not having it. I gave her an extra big tip that surprised her. US dollars were the currency. A small coffee was $2.75, not bad for a kiosk. I knew I was "at the Mall". See y'all at the Mall.
